notes: A concert with a named tour stage is Entertainment — a stage with an audience, which is the Performance Venue preset on venue-stage, where every sightline converges on the stage and the floor is sized for crowd density rather than circulation. The answers set stadium scale, so raked seating is genuinely present and spectator-bleachers carries the tiered elevation; nothing overhangs, so it stays on the proven pipeline. Players attend rather than perform, so I left backstage-support out and kept the build off P3, and treated the tour reference as production styling of the stage rather than a second genre. Audience members walk the floor, so this is a normal walkable build rather than a SET.
